name: uffda-vscode
description: Language support for Uffda (.uff) grammars: diagnostics, highlighting, and an MCP server for AI agent tools.

uffda.lsp.serverPath.markdownDescription: Overrides the executable used to launch the language server and MCP server, bypassing `PATH` resolution and automatic download. Bare names (`uffda`) use PATH; relative paths (`target/release/uffda`) resolve against the uffda workspace folder; absolute paths are used as-is. Resource-scoped so multi-root folder `.vscode/settings.json` applies.

uffda.lsp.serverArgs.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to `#uffda.lsp.serverPath#` when launching the language server, in place of the default `lsp` argument. Only used when `#uffda.lsp.serverPath#` is set. Typical value: `["lsp"]`.

uffda.mcp.serverArgs.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to `#uffda.lsp.serverPath#` when launching the MCP server, in place of the default `mcp` argument. Only used when `#uffda.lsp.serverPath#` is set. Typical value: `["mcp"]`.
